## FAQ

### What's the Best Cooling Topper for a Couple Who Sleep at Different Temperatures?

It depends mostly on your mattress size. On a king or split king, a Twin XL cooling topper like the ViscoSoft Active Cooling can sit on the hot sleeper's half without crossing onto the other side. On a queen, a Twin XL topper extends past the middle, so a half-size active cooling pad such as a Half Queen Sleepme Chilipad is designed to stay on one side. A topper sized for the whole bed covers your partner's side too. If one of you wants cooling and the other wants warming, with separate settings for each side, our [dual-zone bed guide for couples]({{ '/posts/couples-different-sleep-temperatures-dual-zone-bed/' | url }}) compares setups built for that.

### What Bedding Keeps Both Partners Comfortable If One Sleeps Hot?

changes.new:
If no-cost adjustments don't fully solve it, these are the four main categories of dual-zone bed cooling and heating options. They differ a lot in what they can do, how much setup they take, and how much they cost.

What makes bedding "dual-zone" is that each side of the bed gets its own setting. The simplest version, and the closest thing to a dual-zone comforter, is two separate comforters in different weights: nothing is heated or cooled, but each side chooses its own warmth. A dual-control heated pad has two heating zones and usually two controllers, so each partner sets their own side, though it only warms. BedJet works with one unit per side and can warm or move room-temperature air, while water-circulating pads can do both on many systems, with independent sides depending on the model.
